bugs_found_and_fixed.summary: MissingProviderCredentialsError fell through classify_exception() to the generic INTERNAL_ERROR category instead of PROVIDER_ERROR
bugs_found_and_fixed.found_via: real GitHub webhook dogfood against kadireren7/patchfrog#23
bugs_found_and_fixed.root_cause: patchfrog/ops/errors.py's classify_exception() had no isinstance branch for MissingProviderCredentialsError, a RuntimeError subclass that doesn't match any existing GitHub/Provider/Value/Type error branch, so it fell through to the INTERNAL_ERROR catch-all
bugs_found_and_fixed.impact: a routine, actionable deployment-configuration problem (missing/misconfigured provider credential) was indistinguishable from an unexpected internal PatchFrog bug in patchfrog_reviews_failed_total and would show the wrong category to an operator
bugs_found_and_fixed.fix: added an explicit isinstance(exc, MissingProviderCredentialsError) branch returning (PROVIDER_ERROR, retryable=False, str(exc))

no_regression_scenarios: no stuck RUNNING review_runs row after the credential-boundary failure (none was ever created, by design)
no autoretry_for configured on review_pull_request_task -- a non-retryable failure is not retried
